figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 41 for the shape of the new moon: the circle of the sun about ه with its upright diameter from ا (the south, at the top) to ج (the north, at the foot) and its level diameter from ب (the east, at the left) to د (the west, at the right); the level line from ط on that circle through ك to ل at the far left; the upright chord from م to س; the circle of the moon about ز, where the chord م س cuts the line ط ك; the line from ف to ق, the two points where the circles cut each other; and the line through ز and ه, from the moon's circle at the lower left to ع on the sun's circle, which cuts the moon's circle at ح; with the words «الجنوب», «المغرب», «المشرق» and «الشمال» at the top, the right, the left and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec1016.json): the two circles and the six lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); each line is drawn between its meetings with the fitted circles (the line to ل to the end of its ink); the nineteen letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink. The letters stand in types of different sizes in the print: the words in the type of the text (13.8 pt here, narrowed to their printed width), the letters ف ع ح د ه ب ز ك ل ق in its large isolated forms (15.5 pt here, as in the other figures), and ا, س, ج, م and ط smaller (13, 13.5, 10.5, 9.5 and 9.5 pt here, from the height and the width of their printed ink)

corrections: p. 136: the figure stands at the left of the page beside lines 6 to 15, which begin at 390 to 392 pt; lines 1 to 5 run across the page over it and lines 17 to 22 under it; line 16 begins at 198 pt and line 17, the first of a paragraph, is set in (it ends at 477 pt). The automatic geometry took the labels of the figure for parts of the lines and found a false line between the second and the third: the 22 lines are measured from their ink (scratch geom1016.py); the rule and the margin items (line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 at the left, two folio numbers at the right) are those of the automatic geometry, the two note lines are measured from their ink; the figure is redrawn (F01)
